title: Visits
description: What each visitor did, in order. Read from a copy of the analytics database that is rebuilt every few minutes; the copy is also where visits that are the site's own have already been removed, so nothing here needs to filter them.

panels.title: Visits, most recent first: time in sight where measured, and hits

targets.rawQueryText:
select
    substr(lower(hex(h.session)), 1, 8) as visit,
    min(h.created_at) as started,
    coalesce(group_concat(case when (p.event = 1 and substr(p.path, 1, instr(p.path, '/') - 1) in ('site-time', 'rosetta-time', 'examples-time', 'playground-time', 'repl-time')) then p.path end, ', '), 'not measured') as in_sight,
    count(*) as hits,
    sum(p.event = 0) as pages,
    max(h.location) as place,
    case when coalesce(max(h.width), 0) = 0 then 'unknown'
         when max(h.width) < 600 then 'phone'
         when max(h.width) < 1100 then 'tablet'
         else 'desktop' end as screen,
    group_concat(case when not (p.event = 1 and substr(p.path, 1, instr(p.path, '/') - 1) in ('site-time', 'rosetta-time', 'examples-time', 'playground-time', 'repl-time')) then coalesce(nullif(replace(replace(replace(p.path, 'playground.ghul.dev/run/', 'playground-run/'), '/playground.ghul.dev', '/playground'), '/ghul.dev', ''), ''), '/') end, '  ->  ') as went
from hits h join paths p using (path_id)
where h.created_at >= datetime('now', '-' || ${days} || ' days')
group by h.session
order by started desc
limit 200

panels.description: One row per visit, in the order the visitor went. in_sight is the time each page was actually in view, in bands, as the pages report it (site-time, rosetta-time, examples-time, playground-time, repl-time); a visit whose pages sent none says not measured. It is not the time between the first and last hit, which is 0 for a one-hit visit whatever the reader did. The visit id is GoatCounter's own: random, and it lives for one visit. No address is stored anywhere, by GoatCounter or by this.

targets.rawQueryText:
with first as (
    select h.session, min(h.hit_id) as hit_id
    from hits h join paths p using (path_id)
    where p.event = 0 and h.created_at >= datetime('now', '-' || ${days} || ' days')
    group by h.session)
select coalesce(nullif(replace(replace(replace(p.path, 'playground.ghul.dev/run/', 'playground-run/'), '/playground.ghul.dev', '/playground'), '/ghul.dev', ''), ''), '/') as entry_page, count(*) as visits
from first join hits h using (hit_id) join paths p using (path_id)
group by entry_page order by visits desc limit 25

with last as (
    select h.session, max(h.hit_id) as hit_id, count(*) as n
    from hits h join paths p using (path_id)
    where p.event = 0 and h.created_at >= datetime('now', '-' || ${days} || ' days')
    group by h.session)
select coalesce(nullif(replace(replace(replace(p.path, 'playground.ghul.dev/run/', 'playground-run/'), '/playground.ghul.dev', '/playground'), '/ghul.dev', ''), ''), '/') as exit_page, count(*) as visits, sum(last.n = 1) as of_which_bounced
from last join hits h using (hit_id) join paths p using (path_id)
group by exit_page order by visits desc limit 25

panels.title: Commonest steps from one page to the next

targets.rawQueryText:
with seen as (
    select h.session, h.hit_id, coalesce(nullif(replace(replace(replace(p.path, 'playground.ghul.dev/run/', 'playground-run/'), '/playground.ghul.dev', '/playground'), '/ghul.dev', ''), ''), '/') as path,
           lead(coalesce(nullif(replace(replace(replace(p.path, 'playground.ghul.dev/run/', 'playground-run/'), '/playground.ghul.dev', '/playground'), '/ghul.dev', ''), ''), '/')) over (partition by h.session order by h.hit_id) as next_path
    from hits h join paths p using (path_id)
    where p.event = 0 and h.created_at >= datetime('now', '-' || ${days} || ' days'))
select path as from_page, next_path as to_page, count(*) as times
from seen where next_path is not null and next_path <> path
group by path, next_path order by times desc limit 25

targets.rawQueryText:
select
    case when r.ref = '' then '(typed or bookmarked)' else r.ref end as referrer,
    count(distinct h.session) as visits
from hits h left join refs r using (ref_id)
where h.created_at >= datetime('now', '-' || ${days} || ' days') and h.first_visit = 1
group by referrer order by visits desc limit 25
